skills.name: Same-denominator fraction subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract one fraction from another when the denominators are already the same, including zero results and improper fractions.

skills.name: Common denominator conversion
skills.definition: Rewrite fractions with unlike denominators as equivalent fractions with a common denominator before subtraction.

skills.name: Mixed and whole number subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract mixed numbers, whole numbers, or fractions from mixed numbers when the fractional part of the minuend is sufficient.

skills.name: Regrouping and renaming
skills.definition: Rename whole or mixed numbers by borrowing one whole or normalizing improper fractional parts when needed for subtraction.
